annotations.title: Run an API or model call

description: Execute one selected OpenAny API, or send one selected model to chat completions. Requires the caller's OpenAny API key on the MCP connection as Authorization: Bearer <key>. A call with no key is rejected locally and does not reach the gateway. Never ask the user to paste the key into chat; use the client's secure secret settings. First call get_api. Pass its api and api_version, and input that matches input_schema. Model calls can incur charges. Supports finite JSON, UTF-8 plain text and Markdown. Optional output only changes presentation: raw (default), structural summary, or compact for JSON objects/arrays with explicit items_path for nested arrays. A timeout after dispatch has unknown execution or charging state: do not retry automatically.

fields.description: Literal object keys at root object or selected array items. Does not change upstream fields or pricing.

items_path.description: RFC6901 pointer relative to response data. Required to clip a nested array; empty selects a root array.

max_items.description: Returned array limit, default 10 in compact mode. Requires root array or items_path.
